name: Street League Football
summary: Street League Football is an arcade American football game played on city streets, lots and rooftops. Plays are driven by physics: players' bodies and the ball collide, so catches, tackles, jukes and trucks come out of real contact. Modes include Endless, Route Battle 1 on 1, 3 on 3, Kickoff Return and Tackle Alley, plus practice drills, played solo against CPU opponents or online through quick match, ranked 1 on 1 and player-hosted lots. Players customize their athlete in the Locker and can save and export replay clips.
